en.v: “Mr. Zhu, you’d better not eat too much
. You are already overweight,” said the doctor.

examples.zh: 医生说：“朱先生，您最好不要吃太多的肉。您已经超重了。”

errata.original: “Mr. Zhu, you’d better not eat too much meat. You are already over weight,” said the doctor.
